scope: source only; no hosted/VM/provider/deployment action by worker

inputs.PANTHEON_DEPLOY_SEALED_FROM_JSON: exactly {target,dist_sha256,manifest_sha256,frontend_sha,backend_sha}; must equal the current live target
inputs.PANTHEON_DEPLOY_SEALED_TO_JSON: same five fields; the release to select
inputs.lease: existing PANTHEON_DEPLOY_LEASE_{OWNER,EPOCH,RUN_ID,DELEGATED} checks, independent of any prepared receipt

callableContract.directions: same action; return uses the reversed seals (final->baseline, then baseline->same final)
callableContract.result: stdout 'restore-sealed result: {"exchangedOutTarget":...,"liveTarget":...,"operation":"exchange"}' and AUDIT_DIR/restore-sealed-result.json; semantics: FE selection only, paired BFF and hosted/browser acceptance pending
callableContract.failure: exit 2 before mutation on any seal/path/lease/predecessor/CAS rejection; exit 1 with partial-transition message if readback differs from the requested target

behavior: validates both seals, managed direct-child release dirs, regular manifests, manifest sha256, accepted operator-live state, dist digest (release-candidate.mjs digest) and manifest identity (verify_manifest_file) before any mutation
stages an owner link and uses scripts/atomic-symlink-cas.py exchange (unchanged); successful CAS consumes the link
no release creation, manifest/receipt/pair.json/acceptedAt rewrite, build, pull, prepare, reseal, prune, probe or network call
cleanup short-circuits for this action only; ordinary deployment cleanup and evidence requirements are unchanged

added: sealed return round-trips operator-live releases preserving bytes
sealed return rejects bad seals, stale predecessor, and wrong profile
sealed return rejects unmanaged paths and invalid leases
tests.fullSuite: 73 named tests, each run via PANTHEON_TEST_FILTER=<exact name> in three bounded batches: 73 unique ok, 0 not ok (one name matched twice by substring). A single unfiltered 'bash scripts/test-deploy-dev-vm.sh' exceeded the 600s tool limit (34 ok, 0 not ok before termination), so no single unfiltered exit code is recorded.
tests.cas: python3 scripts/test-atomic-symlink-cas.py: Ran 7 tests, OK, exit 0

limitations: fixture baseline is a byte-copy of the accepted operator-live release under a different directory name (distinct target, identical content); a second independently built operator-live release was not constructed
a concurrent live-link change between validation and CAS is covered by the unchanged CAS primitive's own tests, not by a new harness race; the harness covers stale predecessor rejection before CAS
fixture lease fields are not hosted expiry enforcement; the guarded Pantheon caller owns that
local tests are not a hosted round trip or final delivery
